summary: LLM API pricing in late 2026 spans a roughly 100x range, from sub-dollar output rates on lightweight models (e.g., Claude Haiku, GPT-4o mini, Gemini Flash-Lite) to premium frontier tiers above $40-$50 per million output tokens. The dominant trend is explicit task-tier pricing within each vendor's lineup, widespread prompt-caching discounts (typically 10x cheaper on cached input), and batch/flex rates at roughly half the standard price. Most major vendors offer free tiers or trial credits, though premium and newly launched frontier models are increasingly paid-tier only.

models.name: GPT-4o
models.notes: Batch API offers ~50% discount. Cached input priced at half of standard input. Pricing via platform usage tiers.

models.name: GPT-4o mini
models.notes: Low-cost small model. Batch API ~50% discount. Among the cheapest frontier-lab models.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.notes: Prompt caching read at ~10% of input; cache write priced higher. Batch API ~50% discount.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.notes: Free tier via AI Studio with rate limits. Batch requests roughly half price. High-volume, large context model.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.notes: Higher input/output pricing tier applies for prompts over 200K tokens. Free tier available via AI Studio with rate limits. Batch ~half price.

models.name: o4-mini
models.notes: Reasoning model. Cached input at ~25% of standard. Batch API ~50% discount.

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.notes: Fast, low-cost tier. Prompt caching read at ~10% of input. Batch API ~50% discount.

models.name: o3
models.notes: Premium reasoning model. Cached input at ~25% of standard. Batch API ~50% discount.

models.name: Claude Opus 4.8
models.notes: Flagship reasoning model, highest Anthropic tier. Prompt caching read at ~10% of input. Batch API ~50% discount.

models.name: Grok (grok-beta / Grok 4)
models.notes: Pricing via xAI developer platform. Cached input discount available. Rate limits by usage tier.

models.name: Mistral Large
models.notes: Free experimentation tier via La Plateforme with rate limits. Batch API available at reduced cost.

models.name: Mistral Small
models.notes: Low-cost model. Free tier via La Plateforme with rate limits. Batch API available.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B (hosted)
models.notes: Open-weight model served by Together AI; identical input/output rate. Pricing varies by host (Groq, Fireworks often cheaper). Free trial credits available.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B (Groq)
models.notes: High-speed inference on Groq LPU hardware. Free tier with rate limits available for developers.

models.name: Llama 3.1 405B (hosted)
models.notes: Largest open-weight Llama served by Fireworks. Serverless pricing; dedicated deployments available. Free trial credits.

models.name: Command R+
models.notes: Strong RAG and tool-use model. Free trial API keys with rate limits available for evaluation.
